vocabulary_rule: A learning word is defined in plain language only after the child sees or performs its bounded distinction.
layout_rule: Words sit in reserved illustration space or on dedicated paper-activity pages; the book contains no game menus, dashboards or digital controls.
paper_activity_rule: Activities use pointing, tracing, listening, speaking, page turns or separate safe paper only.
repeated_object_rule: Repeated learning objects use the same versioned OpenMoji asset throughout the book and series.
returning_character_rule: Mia, Sol and Tavi are permanent; Nori is the single guest introduced in E01 and may return only when relevant without supplying a later answer.
